prevAppInfoSpec.description: The version and list of Types to generate for the previous mocked version.

curAppInfoSpec.description: The version and list of Types to generate for the current mocked version.

typeMetaChanges.description:
A map of package name to any {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff.TypeMetaChanges} for
the given test case. If this is specified, it will be used instead of the result from
{@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#detectStructuralChanges}. Otherwise, that result
will be generated and used.

detectStructuralChangesMode.description:
How to determine structural changes between #prevAppInfoSpec and #curAppInfoSpec.

  - **DETECT:**   Call {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#detectStructuralChanges} and
                  use those results directly.
  - **OVERRIDE:** Don't call {@link BaseCodeAnalysis.VersionDiff#detectStructuralChanges}.
                  Instead use #typeMetaChanges directly.
